hint.en: Build it from the inside out.

hint.zh: 先引入「今天是周六 ∨ 今天是周日」（另一边放右边），再把它放到一句 ∨ 的右边。
hint.en: First bring in “today is Saturday ∨ today is Sunday” (the other side on the right), then put that on the right of another ∨.

t.zh: 「今天是周末」的意思是：今天是周六，或者今天是周日。至少一个成立，两个都成立也算：正是里的门。
t.en: “It is the weekend” means: today is Saturday, or today is Sunday. At least one holds, and both count too: the gate of .

t.zh: <level-ref to="decl-or"></level-ref>声明了「或者」，随之有了<part-ref to="part:orI"></part-ref>：有了一句话，「它 ∨ 任意一句」就成立。在元件上选它放在左边还是右边，就是选两条引入规则中的哪一条；另一边是哪句话，也在元件上选。
t.en: <level-ref to="decl-or"></level-ref> declared “or”, and with it came <part-ref to="part:orI"></part-ref>: from a sentence, “it ∨ any other” holds. Choosing on the part whether it goes left or right chooses one of the two introduction rules; the other side is chosen on the part too.
